title: Visual asset store tooling: lock and deletion log, faster decoder, byte-reproducible releases, local Aseprite proof, atlases, palettes, animation metadata, bundle evidence
summary: Epic of nine store-tooling children (lock and deletion log, decoder, reproducibility, proof record, atlases, palettes, animation metadata, bundle capture, docs), all done and committed on one branch; PR pending the user's authorization.

title: Animation metadata in the handoff and artifact records, after a registry budget review
summary: Frame durations and tags derived from the source bytes, carried per revision on SourceRecord, opt-in animation.json; bounds 16/16 owner-approved; security review found and fixed one crash.

title: A store-wide lock, an append-only deletion log and kill-mid-publish tests (ADR D24, reverses D18)
summary: Store-wide write lock that refuses a second writer, hash-chained gc deletion log with archiving, kill-mid-publish tests and recovery docs, ADR D24; security review approved with hardening.

title: A faster pure-Python PNG decoder and fewer decodes per adopt, with bounds unchanged (F3)
summary: Pure-Python PNG decoder unfilters rows per channel and decodes a preview once; bounds unchanged; pixel hashes identical over the committed corpus; security review clean.

title: Prove a release candidate rebuilds to identical bytes (local real-Aseprite test + CI export test)
summary: Local rc rebuild byte comparison (rc-0008 70/70 identical) and a CI export-twice and chunk-allowlist test that fails on planted tIME/tEXt/iTXt/zTXt chunks.

title: A committed local real-Aseprite proof record and a CI check that it is not stale (D10 kept)
summary: Committed local Aseprite proof record written only by the full strict make target, CI staleness test naming changed files, ADR D10 addendum (owner approved); refreshed after the last store change.

title: Optional per-set sprite atlases in the runtime export (deterministic packing, extrude and padding), not wired
summary: Opt-in export-runtime --atlas sheets per family with pixel equality and export-twice byte equality; MAX_ATLAS_DIM 1024 owner-approved; review fix: default export holds no decoded image.

title: Committed terrain palette and GPL exports, and an advisory palette-membership lint in the drawing tools
summary: Terrain and icon palettes and GPL exports as drift-guarded data; advisory off-palette lint that never flips ok; colour budgets moved to data with the same values.

title: Repeatable visual evidence: capture the harness pages from a built bundle and commit a compact evidence record
summary: Rehearsal pages captured from the built bundle with a TypeScript pixels-v1 hash proven against Python, a planted one-pixel asset that the capture fails on, and a local-only make target; no gate result moves.

title: Docs drift, handoff snapshots, the hardening epic's stranded staging artifacts, and batch close
summary: Asset docs corrected for what was built and parked, hardening research moved to stored_artifacts, both handover snapshots refreshed, all ten tickets closed.
